title: exam_attempt
description: One sat JLPT-simulation paper: one row per (user, level, attempt number). That triple IS the seed (design/exam_simulator.md §5), so the same learner asking for the same attempt number at the same level gets the same paper — which is what makes a support request answerable months later. RUNTIME class: minted per learner, never committed to this repo. See design/user_state.md §7.

x-yomineko.note: attempt_id is derivable from the seed triple, so no counter is needed. Scaled JLPT scoring landed in W19 (design/exam_scoring.md): `scaled` is filled from a HOUSE APPROXIMATION — a linear map of raw section percent onto the official range — because the real scaled score comes from an unpublished IRT model and cannot be reproduced outside JEES. Both fields stay nullable: `scaled` is null while an attempt is in progress, and `passed` is null whenever a whole scoring section went untested.

level.description: Which paper. Level is DATA, not structure (spec §1.6): banks exist for n5/n4/n3 today and adding one is adding rows.

seed.description: The canonical serialization of (user_id, level, attempt_no) handed to the RNG. Stored rather than recomputed, so a change to the serialization shows up as a diff instead of silently regenerating a different paper under an old attempt number.

seed_algorithm.description: Which selection rule the seed drove — item draw without replacement, option shuffle and section fill are all seeded (design/exam_simulator.md §5, items 1-3). When any of them changes, this value changes and every earlier attempt stays reproducible under the rule it was sat with.

mode.description: `full` is a timed paper; `section` is one section; `study` is the known-set-filtered practice mode. A `study` score must never be reported as a paper result — the item pool is different by construction. Vocabulary owner: design — design/user_state.md#7-exam_attempt. Widening it is an edit there, never a side effect of regenerating this schema from the data.

submitted_at.description: Null while the attempt is in progress.

time_limit_seconds.description: From the timing table verified in design/exam_simulator.md.

items.description: One entry per PRESENTED item, in presentation order.

item.description: The exam-bank item, by stable id. Its prefix names the section (kr/or/cf/gf/so/pp/us/tg/rc/lt/lp/lg/ls/lr).

presented_options.description: The SHUFFLED option order actually shown. Stored because "the seed reproduces it" is a claim that should be checkable against what the learner saw, not only against what the generator would do today.

answer_given.description: Null when the item was left blank.

sections.description: One entry per section the paper contained. The five listening sections cannot appear until their items have audio (W35).

minimum_met.description: Whether this section cleared its sectional minimum. The minimum belongs to the SCORING section this paper section feeds into, not to the paper section itself — the JLPT has no per-大問 minimum (design/exam_scoring.md §6). Null while the attempt is unscored.

scaled.description: The scaled-score estimate (W19; design/exam_scoring.md §5). NOT a JLPT score: the real mapping is an unpublished, per-sitting item-response-theory model, so this is a linear map of raw section percent onto the official range and must be labelled an approximation wherever it is shown. Null while the attempt is in progress.

passed.description: Null until `scaled` exists, and still null when the paper could not test a whole scoring section — a missed section is failure with no results issued, so there is no pass/fail to record (design/exam_scoring.md §6). A pass is the total pass mark AND every sectional minimum, never the total alone.

section.description: The fourteen paper sections declared in design/exam_simulator.md — the same fourteen the exam-bank id prefixes name (kr or cf gf so pp us tg rc lt lp lg ls lr). Two are absent from the real exam at some levels (N5 has no 用法; 概要理解 starts at N3), which is a paper-composition fact and not a vocabulary one. Vocabulary owner: design — design/exam_simulator.md. Widening it is an edit there, never a side effect of regenerating this schema from the data.
